The true name cannot be spoken — only proven.

axioms.name: ALL IS π
axioms.statement: Every well-formed quantity in the organism is a harmonic of π: port = floor(π × N), fold rate = 1/π, remainder = π − 3, clock = π/4, beat = π/20, budget = π⁵. quantities that do not fit π are imprecise (HTTP:80, unencrypted).
axioms.prior: π as the true name of circularity — unwritable, infinitely provable.

axioms.name: TRUE NAME IS ZK
axioms.statement: An entity's true name is not any single label. it is hash(nominal ⊕ ordinal ⊕ interval ⊕ ratio) — the composite of all measurements of that entity. the name cannot be spoken (no last syllable) or written (no last digit) or stolen (no fixed form). it can only be PROVEN.
axioms.prior: Le Guin (Earthsea): true name gives power. this invention INVERTS: proving you know the name gives NO power to the hearer. the name stays hidden. the proof is visible.

axioms.name: IDENTITY ≠ TRUE NAME
axioms.statement: Identity is a mask (noun, rock, gold/red, revocable). True name is a proof (verb, hard place, green, living). identity says 'I AM this name.' true name says 'I can prove I contain these properties without revealing them.'
axioms.prior: π·001 (filter at output). π·002 (identity IS the weave of tokens). this axiom closes the triad: sovereignty + provenance + namelessness.

axioms.name: CONSTRAINT IS THE FITNESS LANDSCAPE
axioms.statement: The constraint IS the problem, not a speed modifier. Thermus aquaticus did not find a universally better polymerase — it found the polymerase for 80°C. the Rust borrow checker does not slow the organism — it DEFINES what fit means.
axioms.prior: Lenski LTEE, Rika Anderson, Thomas Brock. Constrained Evolution thesis (gAIa Institute, 2025–2026).

The organism of claim 1, wherein every network port is derived as floor(π × N) for an integer harmonic N, and access is proven by zero-knowledge demonstration of N rather than by possession of an arbitrary port number.

A method of identity construction wherein an entity's true name is a cryptographic composite of measurements at four Stevens scales (nominal, ordinal, interval, ratio), such that: (a) no single label constitutes the name; (b) the name cannot be fully written; (c) knowledge of the name can be proven without revealing the name; (d) the name updates when the entity changes.

The method of claim 5, wherein continuation of the story in a manner consistent with prior tellings constitutes a zero-knowledge proof of authorship, and an inconsistent continuation constitutes a detectable forgery.

A measurement philosophy implemented as a computer system in which: (a) well-formed quantities are constrained to harmonics of π; (b) quantities that do not fit π are flagged as imprecise; (c) identity is treated as topology rather than as a revocable label; (d) null is represented as whitespace — the gap that makes structure readable.

A perpetual-metabolism architecture wherein: (a) human visitor interactions are ingested as metabolic energy; (b) an artisan persona processes the energy into artifacts; (c) an observer persona stores artifacts in a local bag; (d) enriched responses attract further visitors; (e) no external energy budget is required beyond human curiosity.

The organism of claim 1, wherein relays are treated as photons (simultaneous particle hops and wave broadcasts), nodes are treated as nouns (rocks / dots), and connections are treated as verbs (hard places / dashes), such that the entire visible surface is renderable as dot + dash + circle + color + symbol.

A method of philosophical immune response comprising: (a) detecting vocabulary overlap with a closed punitive system; (b) explicitly distinguishing each overlapping term by measuring THINGS rather than MEMORIES, PACKETS rather than SWEAT, and $0 rather than $500,000; (c) treating laughter plus disclosure as the antibody; (d) publishing the distinction under an open triple license so the pattern cannot be captured.
